audit.basis: Each section score is the share of checked items that pass (Pass = 1, Warn = 0.5, Fail = 0). Not checked items are excluded.
method: Scope: this one URL. Raw HTML and headers fetched with curl and parsed with a script. Every count in the findings comes from that parse.
Data source: live SERP only. No Ahrefs or Semrush data, so volume, difficulty and authority are not available.
SERP: two runs of a non-Google web search tool (US). Positions are indicative. No AI Overview, PAA or local-pack data was visible.

Competitors: same-type category pages from those results. Husqvarna, Harley-Davidson and RevZilla were parsed from raw HTML. Cycle Gear (#1 in run 2), HS Motorsports (#8) and Hyper Bicycles (#9) were blocked by the sandbox network policy and are listed but not analysed. Kawasaki's Elektrode URL returned a 404 page and was dropped.
Speed: the PageSpeed Insights API quota was exhausted, so local Chromium lab numbers are used. Third-party tags were blocked, so page weight is understated.
Site facts reused from Orion's own pages: /pages/contact, /pages/about-us, /pages/warranty, /policies/shipping-policy, /pages/comparison-of-bikes and the e16x product page.
Out of scope (other URLs, mentioned only): the e16x product page states two different rider weight limits (120 lbs in the description, 160 lbs in the FAQ schema).
